The MD&A attributes the R&D increase to 'higher employee-related costs due to an increase in headcount to support increased investment in AI'. The releases cite 'increased R&D investments in AI'. No amount or share is stated.
The Q2 2024 release cites 'increasing our strategic AI investments'. Total R&D was $6.5B, but that is the whole of R&D, not an AI part. No AI amount or share is stated.
AMD announced plans to invest $135M in Ireland R&D for 'next generation AI, data center, networking and 6G' projects. The amount spans non-AI uses and no AI part is stated, so it is not attributed.
The Q3 2025 release cites 'continued investments in AI and high-performance computing'. Total R&D was $8.1B (up 25%), but that is the whole of R&D, not an AI part. No AI amount or share is stated.
